derivations.quote: Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate, each a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i>0$ below one (a margin, not a guard value).
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md). The total is $O(p/K)K^\tau=O(pK^{\tau-1})$.
Over at most $p^A$ visits of volume $O(V)$, and with $d=O(p^\epsilon)$, the repair costs $O(Vp^{O(1)}2^{-K})=o(V)$, because $K=\Theta(p^{\epsilon c})$ beats every power of $p$.
Each of the seven powers is at most $1-2\kappa$, and any fixed power of $\log p$ is at most $p^\kappa$ eventually, which the margin $2\kappa$ leaves room for.

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored bits of the T coefficients of p bits, equal to Tp and Theta(n); not the larger label of the subspace-label pages.
symbols.quote: Let $V=Tp=\Theta(n)$ be the volume, the number of stored bits of $T$ coefficients of $p$ bits (a volume here, not the larger label of the subspace-label pages).

symbols.name: margin
symbols.meaning: The distance below one of the exponent of p in the i-th dominant normalized cost, so the cost is p^{1-g_i}.
symbols.quote: Dividing by $V$, seven operations dominate, each a power $p^{1-g_i}$ with margin $g_i>0$ below one (a margin, not a guard value).

symbols.name: visit exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that the recursions make at most p^A visits; not the shear matrix or a space of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit (here $A$ and $C$ are exponents, not the shear matrix, ambient spaces, two-point kernel or selection map of earlier pages).

symbols.name: setup exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent such that descriptor setup takes at most p^C steps per visit; not the two-point kernel or selection map of earlier pages.
symbols.quote: Fix an exponent $A$ with at most $p^A$ visits in total, and an exponent $C$ with descriptor setup of at most $p^C$ steps per visit (here $A$ and $C$ are exponents, not the shear matrix, ambient spaces, two-point kernel or selection map of earlier pages).

symbols.name: call volume
symbols.meaning: The volume of one packed change of basis.
symbols.quote: Let $V_{\rm call}$ be the volume of one packed change of basis.

relations.quote: Cost accounting totals the running time of every step of [The multiplication algorithm](multiplication-algorithm.md) and shows that it is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$, where $\kappa=2^{-182}$ is the saved exponent.
The layout needs $O(p/K)$ chunk exchanges, as $d\ell=O(p)$, each costing $O(VK^\tau)$ by [Fast address-chunk interchange](address-interchange.md).
Each of at most $\ell$ rounds costs $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$ by [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-layer.md).
Exceptional addresses, where the packed shifts of [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md) fail, are bounded to a fraction $O(d2^{-K})$ of addresses.
